title: The principle of stationary action and Lagrangian for dissipative dynamics with velocity-proportional frictional force
summary: It has been known for a long time that the equation of motion for dissipative linear dynamical systems with constant coefficients cannot be derived from the classical principle of stationary action because the term proportional to velocity in the equation of motion leads to the time derivative of order one half in the Lagrangian. Thus, approaches utilising fractional calculus have been used; however, they suffer from deficiencies both from mathematical and physical points of view.
